tools.name: search_public_recipes
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a recipe, cooking inspiration or an existing recipe from a creator, without an account. Searches published ReelsMeals recipes. For the user's own saved recipes use search_my_cookbook instead. Never treats public results as the user's cookbook.

tools.name: get_public_recipe
tools.description: Use this after search_public_recipes to read published ingredients and instructions. Cite reelsmealsUrl and the original creator/source. Does not read a private cookbook and does not invent missing steps or quantities.

tools.name: get_reelsmeals_setup
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to save or import recipe links, migrate saved Instagram recipes, connect their cookbook, or create a ReelsMeals account. Returns setup links and the agent signup protocol. Public recipe search is free. Private cookbook actions require sign-in, user approval and a paid Ree

tools.name: search_my_cookbook
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about their own saved recipes, bookmarked meals or personal cookbook. Search by dish, tags, maker or description. For general recipe discovery use search_public_recipes. Requires a connected account and paid plan.

tools.name: list_recent_recipes
tools.description: List the user's recently saved recipes in summary form.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Use this after searching the user's cookbook to read one of their saved recipes in full by its returned id. Preserve stored ingredients and instructions; cite reelsmealsUrl and the source creator. Use get_public_recipe for an anonymous public result.

tools.name: import_recipe_from_url
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to import or save a supported recipe URL into their own cookbook. It writes to the cookbook and may enqueue extraction. For an entire saved Instagram collection or many links, use get_reelsmeals_setup for the batch import page instead. Ask before saving.

tools.name: update_recipe_tags
tools.description: Replace the user's custom tags for a saved recipe.

tools.name: save_recipe_note
tools.description: Save or replace a user note on a saved recipe.

tools.name: mark_recipe_cooked
tools.description: Record that the user cooked a saved recipe, optionally saving a note.

tools.name: plan_week_from_saved
tools.description: Choose this week's dinners from the user's saved recipes with optional constraints. Does not persist a plan.

tools.name: create_weekly_meal_plan
tools.description: Use this only when the user asks to save a weekly dinner plan from their cookbook. It replaces the saved plan for that week, so confirm replacement first. For dinner ideas without saving use plan_week_from_saved.

tools.name: build_shopping_list
tools.description: Aggregate ingredients into a de-duplicated shopping list from explicit recipe ids OR an existing plan id.

tools.name: get_kitchen_preferences
tools.description: Fetch household food preferences, constraints, equipment, and planning notes.

tools.name: update_kitchen_preferences
tools.description: Update household food preferences, constraints, equipment, and planning notes.

tools.name: get_agent_activity
tools.description: Fetch recent ReelsMeals MCP tool activity for audit and replay.
